about.title: About Us
about.description: The Kurdish Virtual Laboratory is the first online laboratory platform designed specifically for Kurdish-speaking university students.
about.missionText: To make laboratory education more accessible and interactive for students who have limited access to laboratory facilities.
about.goal1: Help Kurdish university students learn laboratory techniques interactively.
about.goal2: Allow students to practice laboratory procedures virtually.
about.goal3: Teach students how to use laboratory equipment correctly.
about.goal4: Teach students the correct order of laboratory procedures.
about.goal5: Allow instructors to supervise and monitor students.
about.goal6: Provide a safe environment where students can make mistakes and learn from them.
